title: PeoplePulse
tagline: People-analytics MIS + guard-railed GenAI HR assistant (real IBM HR data)
highlights: People-analytics MIS on a PostgreSQL/SQLite star schema with 11 SQL views, built from the real IBM HR Attrition dataset (Kaggle, DbCL-1.0; 1,470 employees).
Guard-railed GenAI natural-language-to-SQL HR assistant (sqlglot validation + view allow-listing + PII refusals): 100% on 15 questions and 10 adversarial prompts.
Attrition-risk model (logistic regression + gradient boosting) at ROC-AUC 0.82 on a stratified hold-out, with Streamlit + Power BI (DAX) dashboards and an n8n onboarding automation.
